name: Outpost Expedition
author: vkays
description: Makes the game's unused Oupost map reachable. Oupost.zax ships with Lionheart but nothing links to it: 934 entities of finished Outpost / Dwarf Region level, with working doors and a spawn point, and no NPCs, dialogue or quests. Quinn the Herbalist gains a dialogue option that takes you there, and a door beside the arrival point brings you back. The map itself is the developers' own, unmodified apart from that door. Requires test-pocket and must load after it: both ship Quinn's dialogue, and this copy is built on top of that one so its option survives.
